# JabKit component

Search the JabKit MCP catalogue first. Show the install plan before writing. Install verbatim with `npx jabkit add <name>`, then apply requested modifications separately. Use semantic tokens rather than hardcoded colors.

Also read `/ROADMAP/00-conventions.md`.
